title: Just Seventeen
style: grunge alt-rock, 96 BPM, raw emotional male vocal NZ/AU accent late teens delivery, acoustic and electric guitar blend, youthful intensity, first love or first loss theme, no production gloss, breath audible, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
Just seventeen and acting like I knew
Just seventeen and thinking I had you
Just seventeen and everything was clear
Just seventeen — before the disappear

[CHORUS]
Just seventeen
The world was all just colour
Just seventeen
Before it got much smaller
Just seventeen
Before I learned what loss was
Just seventeen — that's the cause

[VERSE 2]
Put the songs away at twenty-three
Thought the world had finished listening to me
Kept them in the boxes on the shelf
Just seventeen — talking to myself

[BRIDGE]
Thirty years later they're still here.
Still the same songs.
Still the same kid.
Still seventeen in the verses.

[OUTRO]
Just seventeen. Still.
